title: GravOp: fast gravothermal evolution of self-interacting dark matter haloes, with a kinetically tested conductivity closure
description: Source release of a semi-implicit Lagrangian gravothermal solver for self-interacting dark matter haloes, its selectable conductivity closure, a Fourier neural operator emulator with a learned collapse clock and clock-error-aware uncertainty, static baryonic potentials and a Bayesian inference pipeline. It includes the code of the closure test against NSphere particle simulations (particle-number ladders, four pre-registered haloes, the five- and seven-halo fits), the figure scripts, the acceptance suite, and the statecond benchmark of conditioning coordinates for neural PDE surrogates. The machine-readable results, per-run particle measurements and rendered figures are deposited in a companion archival record.

notes: The machine-readable results, per-run particle measurements, selected trained weights and the rendered figures are in a companion archival record; extract its results/, experiments/ and data/ into a checkout of this release at the same version tag to run the acceptance suite and the reproduction targets. Each tree carries a MANIFEST.sha256, and the SHA-256 of that manifest names the snapshot.
